section.title: Scenario
section.p: Adding a `Subscription` entity with FK to `User`, monthly invoice rows, and an index serving the dashboard query. Owner: tl:alex; reviewer: tl:bob; cadence: per-release.

list.item: Each prerequisite supplied per the AGENTS.md table; sources linked.
Existing artefact catalogue checked for duplicates (none found).

section.p: The team runs the five-step procedure in `content/04-procedure.xml`, recording one paragraph per step. At step 4 the self-check triggers a fix on the rationale (no input cited); re-check passes. The artefact emits with status='ready-for-owner-review'.

section.title: Second worked example — orders + line-items, JSONB column split out
section.p: A service tracks orders with multiple line items. Entities: customers, products, orders, order_items, addresses, payments — six tables, an FK on every relationship, `UNIQUE(order_id, line_no)` on order_items, `CHECK(amount_cents >= 0)`.
Indexes: `(customer_id, created_at)` for the dashboard list query and `(status, created_at)` for the worker queue scan — both confirmed by EXPLAIN against the workload sample, neither speculative.

Migration plan is expand-then-contract because a legacy `orders.shipping_address_text` JSONB column is being normalised into an `addresses` table. Release N: add `addresses` + a nullable `orders.shipping_address_id`. Release N+1: backfill and dual-write. Release N+2: drop `shipping_address_text`. Deliverables — schema-spec.md, erd.png, migration-plan.md — are all reproducible from the CREATE TABLE DDL.

list.item: The decision tree in `content/06-decision-tree.xml` saved one round at step 1 by ruling out a duplicate artefact.
Without the self-check at step 4 the rationale would have shipped without input citations.
